description: TTE2 reference vectors (docs/architecture/e2e-format.md). Fields ending in Hex are lowercase hexadecimal, ciphertextBase64 is standard base64 with padding, sealed values are base64url without padding as on the wire. The plaintext of every file vector is plaintextLength bytes where byte i is i mod 251. Salts and nonces are fixed: sealing again with them must reproduce the ciphertext exactly. A negative or validator input is the concatenation of its parts: {base, from, to} is ciphertext[from:to] of the file vector named base, {hex} is literal bytes. keyHex, when present, replaces the transfer key; index replaces the file index. expectedError names the sentinel error (Go names), empty for success.

secretsDescription: One-time secrets (e2e-format.md section 3.3, since 2.1). Each secret has its own key (keyHex, keyFragment). passphrase is the input before NFC normalization and passphraseNfcHex its UTF-8 bytes after NFC; descriptor is absent without a passphrase. passphraseKeyHex is P = PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256(NFC passphrase, salt, 600000, 32), rootKeyHex is K' = HKDF-SHA256(K, salt = P or empty, "transteira/tte2/v1/secret"). keyProofHex, keyVerifierHex, proofHex and verifierHex are the wire forms of the proofs and their SHA-256. sealedText is the text sealed with textNonceHex. file, when present, is a file stream with transfer key K' and index 0 (plaintext: byte i is i mod 251) and its sealed metadata. A secretNegative case starts from the secret named by secret, replaces its key (keyHex), passphrase (passphrase, even empty), descriptor (descriptor, or none with noDescriptor) and sealed text (sealed); it derives K', then seals text when present, else opens the sealed text; expectedError is the first error. keyProofValid tells whether the key proof of the key used matches the key verifier of the secret, proofValid whether the proof of the derived K' matches its verifier (false when the derivation fails).
